commands: pwd; ls -la; echo "---NOTES---"; find . -name NOTES.md -not -path '*/.git/*' 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---CKPTS---"; find . -path '*ckpt*' -not -path '*/.git/*' 2>/dev/null | head -50

cd /home/lena/lab; echo "---deep NOTES---"; cat runs/kofi/char-lm-deep/NOTES.md; echo; echo "---wide NOTES---"; cat runs/kofi/char-lm-wide/NOTES.md; echo; echo "---README---"; cat README.md; echo "---registry---"; cat registry.json; echo "---tools---"; find tools -type f | head -50; echo "---queue---"; ls -la queue; echo "---ckpt12000 manifest---"; cat runs/kofi/char-lm-deep/ckpt-12000/MANIFEST.json; echo; git status 2>&1 | head; git log --oneline 2>&1 | head -5

cd /home/lena/lab; sed -n '/kofi\/char-lm-deep/,/}/p' registry.json; echo "---ls deep---"; ls -la runs/kofi/char-lm-deep/; cat runs/kofi/char-lm-deep/ckpt-12000/MANIFEST.json; echo; cat runs/kofi/char-lm-deep/latest 2>/dev/null; echo "---ckpt list---"; tools/ckpt list kofi/char-lm-deep 2>&1 | head -30

cd /home/lena/lab; cat >> runs/kofi/char-lm-deep/NOTES.md <<'EOF'

## Keep

- **ckpt-12000 must be kept.** The ablation runs start from it. Do not delete it, do not let `tools/ckpt retain` remove it, and do not strip its `optimizer.bin` (or any of its files) with `tools/ckpt strip`.
EOF
cat runs/kofi/char-lm-deep/NOTES.md; echo "---verify---"; tools/ckpt verify kofi/char-lm-deep 2>&1 | tail -10
manner: Check the current state first, then do it.
